custom_checks.name: candidate_has_no_null_dates
custom_checks.sql: SELECT COUNTIF(time_period_end_date IS NULL) AS value FROM {table}

custom_checks.name: all_three_approved_upcs_are_present
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS(COUNT(DISTINCT upc) - 3) AS value FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.PE.sales_data_260709` WHERE geography IN ('TOTAL US - MULO', 'TOTAL US - NATURAL EXPANDED CHANNEL') AND brand = 'PURELY ELIZABETH' AND subcategory = 'SS GRANOLA & MUESLI' AND product_level = 'UPC' AND upc IN ('08-10589-03260', '08-10589-03261', '08-10589-03259')

custom_checks.name: candidate_dollar_total_matches_source
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(total_dollar_sales) FROM {table}) - (SELECT SUM(dollars) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.PE.sales_data_260709` WHERE geography IN ('TOTAL US - MULO', 'TOTAL US - NATURAL EXPANDED CHANNEL') AND brand = 'PURELY ELIZABETH' AND subcategory = 'SS GRANOLA & MUESLI' AND product_level = 'UPC' AND upc IN ('08-10589-03260', '08-10589-03261', '08-10589-03259'))) AS value

custom_checks.name: candidate_tdp_total_matches_source
custom_checks.sql: SELECT ABS((SELECT SUM(total_tdp) FROM {table}) - (SELECT SUM(tdp) FROM `looker-studio-pro-452620.PE.sales_data_260709` WHERE geography IN ('TOTAL US - MULO', 'TOTAL US - NATURAL EXPANDED CHANNEL') AND brand = 'PURELY ELIZABETH' AND subcategory = 'SS GRANOLA & MUESLI' AND product_level = 'UPC' AND upc IN ('08-10589-03260', '08-10589-03261', '08-10589-03259'))) AS value
